findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional — Close publishes a new pull request here, then records the owner's merge wait only after checks pass (`src/forge/close.py:465-467`). The one-publication guard leaves that wait out of the PR body. On another machine, `nextstep.person_waits` falls back to an undated merge wait (`src/forge/nextstep.py:913-916`), so Needs you cannot show its duration or place it correctly among dated waits. The changed board tests call close a second time before checking the shared view (`tests/test_board_needs_you.py:96-99`, `tests/test_board_counts.py:170-175`), although a normal first close already reports the PR ready.
findings.title: A new ready pull request has no dated merge wait on other machines

stop.reason: Owner chose on 2026-10-16: split the one-body-publish rule, with this dated merge-wait case, into its own fix; this fix keeps the plan update on narrow and split, the fix amend step and the sync pin

why: About 40% of review rounds are process waste: narrowing needs hand merges of the plan, rounds run with no change, and Forge's own records cost rounds and API calls
